text.en: A person whose chosen name outshone his birth name.

This prose lesson is about Kalaignar M. Karunanidhi, whose adopted name outlived his given name and in whom art took pride. It cites Professor Anbazhagan's view that he was a thinker who spread rational ideas, and presents him as a many-sided artist, a writer, orator, dramatist and film writer.
It shows many faces of an artist and how art can serve society. It also encourages us to develop our own talents.
Terms: பன்முகம் (many-sided), கலைஞர் (artist), எழுத்தாளர் (writer) and பேச்சாளர் (orator).
